title: Term Life Insurance New Business: Issue, Placement and Declined Applications
content:
**New business guideline — Term Life Insurance.**

1. A tier is issued only to an insured whose age last birthday on the issue date lies between the tier's lowest and highest issue ages, for a face amount between the tier's smallest and largest face amounts.
2. The waiver of premium rider is attached only when the issue age does not exceed the product's highest waiver rider issue age.
3. The first installment is billed on the issue date.
4. The policy is placed in force on the later of the delivery date and the date the first installment is paid in full; the paid-to date is then the issue date advanced by one premium-mode period.
5. An application that is declined or withdrawn before placement is closed as declined, and any premium received with it is refunded in full without interest.
6. A request to issue a tier outside its issue ages or face limits cannot be met by changing the dates or amounts and is not processed.

### Placement date — hypothetical cases

| Delivery date | First installment paid in full | Placed in force on |
|---|---|---|
| 10 May | 4 May | 10 May (the later date) |
| 10 May | 18 May | 18 May (the later date) |

Paid-to date, hypothetical: a policy issued on 15 January in quarterly mode has a paid-to date of 15 April once placed; in monthly bank-draft mode, 15 February; in annual mode, 15 January of the following year.

### Basis Q&A

**Does a declined applicant receive interest on the premium returned?** No; the refund is the premium received, in full, without interest.

**Can an applicant just past the highest issue age be issued by moving the issue date back?** No; a request outside the issue ages or face limits is not met by changing dates or amounts.
